cta.title: Let's build
cta.highlight: the supply chain of the future
cta.description: Supporting businesses, cooperatives, household businesses and families as they find, choose and manage their food needs.
cta.step1Text: Quickly complete the online form for a business, cooperative, individual or household.
cta.step2Text: Registration details are reviewed according to the system's process before your account is activated.
cta.step3Text: Explore products, select quantities, prepare quotes and view shopping information in your account.

hero.eyebrow: A food sourcing and shopping platform for organizations and individuals
hero.categoriesLabel: A wide range of food categories

why.heading: More than buying food.
why.description: BTB is envisioned as a central food sourcing and shopping platform for individuals and organizations that purchase regularly.
why.businessTitle: Buy according to your organization's process.
why.personalTitle: Find food that fits your family's routine.
why.businessDescription: Focus on specifications, quantities, quotations, delivery addresses and purchase reconciliation.
why.personalDescription: Find familiar items, see clear product information and manage everyday shopping needs.
why.imageLabel: Placeholder for an illustration of how to use BTB
why.notice: Delivery, approvals, history-based personalization and inventory data describe the product direction; these have not been confirmed as working backend features.

benefits.title: Many food categories, one place to search
benefits.description: A central catalog for fresh ingredients, dry goods, prepared food and essentials makes searching and comparing easier.

benefits.title: Pricing by quantity for each product
benefits.description: Each product can have quantity-based pricing. An item's price tier is not calculated from the total order quantity.

benefits.title: Clear quotations and order information
benefits.description: The process is intended to check products, quantities, prices and inventory and retain confirmed details before ordering.

benefits.title: Suitable for different purchasing needs
benefits.description: Businesses, cooperatives, shops, household businesses and families differ in how they search, what they buy and how often.

benefits.title: A clear purchasing journey
benefits.description: The interface follows each step: discovering, choosing, requesting, tracking and reviewing history.

benefits.title: Your account at the center
benefits.description: The goal is to manage details, addresses, quotes and orders in one account instead of looking in multiple places.

model.heading: How does the BTB model
model.description: This is how the Bite to Business platform is envisioned: connecting suppliers, a product catalog, the ordering process and the user experience.
model.clarification: It is not an F&B business model.
model.suppliersText: Product information, specifications, pricing and inventory data within the system.
model.platformText: Organizes the catalog, product selection, quotations and order processing.
model.buyersText: Businesses, cooperatives, household businesses and individuals or families.
model.businessText: The business introduction emphasizes quotations, pricing by item quantity, delivery addresses and organizational purchasing details.
model.personalText: The personal introduction emphasizes product search, choosing specifications, remembering needs and accessing a personal profile.
model.note: Changing the interface preference does not change account permissions, pricing policies or registration conditions.
model.imageLabel: Placeholder for a supplier and buyer diagram

steps.title: Explore the catalog
steps.text: Buyers browse products, brands, units and suitable specifications.

steps.title: Choose quantities and prices
steps.text: Quantity price tiers apply to each product, not the total quantity across the order.

steps.title: Create a request or quote
steps.text: Products and purchase requirements are collected for review and processing.

steps.title: Check and confirm
steps.text: The B2B design includes checking details, pricing, stock and terms before confirmation.

steps.title: Place and receive orders
steps.text: Order and delivery status are planned for a future backend integration.

steps.title: Manage your account
steps.text: Review account details, addresses and purchase history when backend support is available.
